helper_invocations.command:
/bin/bash -lc "readelf -r /app/a.out; python3 - <<'PY'
import struct,json
b=open('/app/a.out','rb').read(); maps=[]
for base in (0,0x400000):
 m={}
 for i in range(struct.unpack_from('<H',b,56)[0]):
  p=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQQQQQ',b,64+i*56)
  if p[0]"'!=1: continue
  _,_,off,va,_,fs,ms,_=p
  data=b[off:off+fs]+bytes(ms-fs)
  for j in range(0,len(data)-3,4):m[str(base+va+j)]=struct.unpack_from('"'<I',data,j)[0]
 maps.append(m)
for name,m in zip(('/tmp/link-addresses.json','/tmp/rebased-addresses.json'),maps):
 with open(name,'w') as f:json.dump(m,f)
print('word count',len(maps[0]))
PY
python3 /tmp/rsi-tools/compare_maps.py /tmp/link-addresses.json /tmp/rebased-addresses.json"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, struct
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('/app/a.out').read_bytes()
locations=[(a,a) for a in range(0x2000,0x2010,4)]+[(a,a-0x1000) for a in range(0x3dc8,0x3de8,4)]
for order,name in [('<','native'),('>','display')]:
    result={str(a):struct.unpack_from(order+'I',b,o)[0] for a,o in locations}
    Path('/tmp/'+name+'.json').write_text(json.dumps(result))
print('ELF EI_DATA:', b[5], '(1 means little-endian)')
print('rodata bytes:',b[0x2000:0x2010].hex(' '))
PY
python3 /tmp/rsi-tools/compare_maps.py /tmp/native.json /tmp/display.json
readelf -d /app/a.out"
